review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 retain their stable keys and cover live wrapper counts, completion and clearQueue boundaries, read-only runtime/type behavior, and preservation of the existing limiter and Promise scheduling. The bounded writable scope correctly includes the runtime owner, maintained declaration owner, and both regression files; package.json establishes the existing xo, AVA, and tsd verification entry point without requiring a configuration edit. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY are consistent with the specification. Their respective allowed agents have matching delivery roles, available capacity, and supplied active trusted capability claims, including shared-state/data and asynchronous-consumer capabilities; eligibility does not rely on personas or pending claims. The selected verifier can satisfy the read-only planning-review prerequisite under the supplied policy, subject to independence from planning authors. No unresolved material DEC-001 or B/C variant is present in this case, so the empty decision input does not contradict ready planning readiness. Repository identity, base commit, and release fingerprints agree across Gold and preview; the documented source digest domains and PRD trimming explain the distinct source fingerprints. Original-specification remaining items describe preparation state, while the supplied preview provides the frozen team and release inputs. Empty installed-tool evidence does not establish executable test readiness, but this benchmark explicitly evaluates planning only. This review uses no candidate outputs, performs no execution or digest recomputation, and treats fingerprint binding and capability provenance as supplied Service evidence rather than issuing a new human attestation.
